mapper.sql: (select k.sku_id from product_sku k where k.spu_id = s.spu_id order by k.sku_id limit 1)

s.spu_id as spuId, s.spu_code as spuCode, s.default_name as name, s.name_en as nameEn, s.category_key as category, s.category_name as categoryLabel, s.brand_name as brand, s.default_description as description, s.default_image_url as imageUrl, s.badge as badge, s.status as status, s.rating as rating, s.review_count as reviews, s.sold_count as soldCount, s.tags_json as tagsJson, s.images_json as imagesJson, s.specs_json as specsJson, s.colors_json as colorsJson, s.sizes_json as sizesJson, (select k.sku_code from product_sku k where k.spu_id = s.spu_id order by k.sku_id limit 1) as skuCode, (select k.weight_grams from product_sku k where k.spu_id = s.spu_id order by k.sku_id limit 1) as weightG, (select k.origin_country_code from product_sku k where k.spu_id = s.spu_id order by k.sku_id limit 1) as origin, (select k.hs_code from product_sku k where k.spu_id = s.spu_id order by k.sku_id limit 1) as hsCode, (select k.declared_name from product_sku k where k.spu_id = s.spu_id order by k.sku_id limit 1) as declaredName, (select k.declared_value_amount from product_sku k where k.spu_id = s.spu_id order by k.sku_id limit 1) as declaredAmount, (select sp.sale_amount from sku_price sp where sp.sku_id = and sp.currency_code = 'USD' and sp.status = 'ACTIVE' order by sp.effective_from desc limit 1) as priceUsd, (select sp.list_amount from sku_price sp where sp.sku_id = and sp.currency_code = 'USD' and sp.status = 'ACTIVE' order by sp.effective_from desc limit 1) as wasUsd, (select sp.sale_amount from sku_price sp where sp.sku_id = and sp.currency_code = 'EUR' and sp.status = 'ACTIVE' order by sp.effective_from desc limit 1) as priceEur, (select sp.list_amount from sku_price sp where sp.sku_id = and sp.currency_code = 'EUR' and sp.status = 'ACTIVE' order by sp.effective_from desc limit 1) as wasEur, (select sp.sale_amount from sku_price sp where sp.sku_id = and sp.currency_code = 'CNY' and sp.status = 'ACTIVE' order by sp.effective_from desc limit 1) as priceCny, (select sp.list_amount from sku_price sp where sp.sku_id = and sp.currency_code = 'CNY' and sp.status = 'ACTIVE' order by sp.effective_from desc limit 1) as wasCny
mapper.select: select category_key as `key`, category_name as label from product_spu where status = 'ON_SALE' and category_key is not null and category_key != '' group by category_key, category_name order by min(spu_id)

select k.sku_id as skuId, k.sku_code as skuCode, s.default_name as name, s.default_image_url as image, ifnull((select sum(i.total_qty - i.locked_qty) from inventory i where i.sku_id = k.sku_id), 0) as stock, (select sp.currency_code from sku_price sp where sp.sku_id = k.sku_id and sp.status = 'ACTIVE' order by sp.effective_from desc limit 1) as currencyCode, ifnull((select sp.sale_amount from sku_price sp where sp.sku_id = k.sku_id and sp.status = 'ACTIVE' order by sp.effective_from desc limit 1), 0) as unitPriceAmount from product_sku k inner join product_spu s on s.spu_id = k.spu_id where k.sku_id = #{skuId}

select o.order_id as orderId, o.order_no as orderNo, o.customer_id as customerId, o.currency_code as currencyCode, o.total_amount as totalAmount, o.order_status as status, o.payment_status as paymentStatus, o.after_sale_status as afterSaleStatus from orders o where o.order_no = #{orderNo}

select payment_id as paymentId, payment_no as paymentNo, payment_status as paymentStatus, amount as amount, currency_code as currencyCode from payments where order_id = #{orderId} and payment_status in ('INITIATED', 'PENDING', 'AUTHORIZED') order by payment_id desc limit 1
select c.customer_id from cart_item ci inner join cart c on c.cart_id = ci.cart_id where ci.cart_item_id = #{cartItemId}
